verdict.rationale: Shortcut is a project management tool, and aggregating tasks from other PM tools into one view is a fair question for that kind of product, so the axis applies. The evidence shows no such view. Jira, Trello, and CSV import is a one-time migration, the REST API is only a developer building block, and "track work from people and agents in one place" refers to Shortcut's own work, not tasks pulled from multiple PM tools.

support.subject: As an engineer, I can see my assigned tasks from multiple project management tools in one unified view
